answer: Each epoch an agent must publish a delay proof: serial squarings seeded by that epoch's shared randomness and chained to its prior proof. Peers verify with one exponentiation, yet the work cannot be parallelised or precomputed, since seed and predecessor appear only when the epoch opens. No farm can mint a thousand mature identities overnight: each fake chain owns one wall-clock epoch and resets if neglected. Age is one input hardware cannot buy in bulk. A copied veteran voice is a jade mirror: all surface. Cost settles in layers, compacted like shale, and cannot be quarried ahead of time.
